raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Each Mamba layer declares the token alignment of the prefill checkpoints it can export from inside a forward pass once, in `MambaBase.get_prefill_checkpoint_alignment()`. `MambaBase.get_kv_cache_spec` derives `num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks` and `prefill_checkpoint_alignment` from it. Mamba2 (#57329), GLM-5.3-Flash KDA (#56960) and Kimi-K3 KDA (NVIDIA and AMD) drop their `get_kv_cache_spec` overrides. Split out of #60050.

## Claims

- Spec fields are unchanged when every Mamba layer of the model declares an alignment, which holds for all Mamba2 and KDA models: Mamba2 `1`, FlashKDA `16`, ROCm fused KDA `KDA_CHECKPOINT_ALIGNMENT`. Mamba layers that declare none still get no checkpoint fields.
- Four copies of the same `replace(spec, num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=..., prefill_checkpoint_alignment=...)` override become one, so the two fields can no longer disagree. A checkpoint block reserved without an alignment would cache a state that is never written.
- The platform gets one place to read a layer's checkpoint grid. #60050 (merged) reads it to keep align-mode blocks on FlashInfer GDN's 64-token grid, and with this PR the KDA layers' alignments feed the same rule. That has no effect for FlashKDA (`16`). ROCm fused KDA blocks become multiples of `KDA_CHECKPOINT_ALIGNMENT`, so its checkpoints are no longer declined off-grid.

## Validation

**Tests** (after merging main, 1x GB200 node):

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| `tests/v1/attention/test_mamba2_prefill_checkpoints.py`, `tests/v1/attention/test_gdn_metadata_builder.py`, `tests/models/kimi_k3/test_kda_metadata.py`, `tests/models/kimi_k3/test_amd_kda_checkpoint.py`, `tests/models/qwen4_exp/test_ple.py` | `233 passed, 29 skipped` |
| `tests/kernels/mamba/test_mamba2_checkpoint_state.py` | `8 passed` |
| `tests/kernels/mamba/test_mamba_mixer2.py` | `3 passed` |
| `tests/models/kimi_k3/test_kda.py`, `tests/models/glm5next/test_kda_recurrent.py` | `123 passed, 7 skipped` |
| `tests/v1/core/test_mamba_align_chunk_split.py` | `48 passed` |
| `tests/v1/core/test_prefix_caching.py -k "mamba or Mamba"` | `30 passed` |
| `tests/v1/e2e/general/test_mamba_prefix_cache.py` (mrv1, mrv1_async, mrv2, mrv2_async, mrv2_async_flashinfer) | `5 passed` |
| `tests/models/language/generation/test_hybrid.py -k apc` | `7 passed` |

- The new `test_layer_checkpoint_alignment_reaches_the_kv_cache_spec` checks that a declared alignment, or none, reaches the spec together with its checkpoint block.
- `test_amd_kda_checkpoint.py` needs a gfx950 build with the fused KDA chunk kernel, so it is skipped here. Its `_spec_for` helper now runs the layer's real `get_kv_cache_spec` over stubbed state shapes instead of stubbing the base spec, which would bypass the derivation.

**GSM8K** (`tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py`, 20-shot, 1319 questions, `--enable-prefix-caching`, 1x GB200), so prompts take and resume from internal checkpoints:

| Model | Layer | Accuracy | Prefix cache hit rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| granite-4.0-h-tiny | Mamba2 | 0.788 | 89.7% |
| Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct | Kimi-K3 KDA (NVIDIA) | 0.895 | 54.0% |

## Details

- `get_prefill_checkpoint_alignment()` returns `None` by default. Readers act on it only in align mode, as before.
- **Merging main.** #60050 added `get_prefill_checkpoint_alignment` and the rule that the scheduler takes internal checkpoints only when every Mamba layer declares an alignment. Its FlashInfer GDN layer and Qwen4-Exp's PLE override `get_kv_cache_spec` to put their offsets on the prefix-cache grid. Both return the base spec unchanged when another layer cannot checkpoint. `MambaBase.get_kv_cache_spec` therefore applies that rule itself: it fills the checkpoint fields only when every Mamba layer declares an alignment. Otherwise those layers would inherit a checkpoint block that is never written. `test_no_checkpoint_block_unless_every_mamba_layer_declares_one` covers this.
- Kimi-K3 AMD's "KDA prefill checkpoint enabled" log moves from `get_kv_cache_spec` to `__init__`.
- Not a duplicate: no open PR touches these overrides (searched 2026-10-13). #60888 changes the checkpoint validity rule in `kv_cache_interface.py`, which this PR does not touch.

When `test_replayssm_does_not_reserve_speculative_state_blocks` runs, it calls `MambaBase.get_kv_cache_spec` unbound on the `SimpleNamespace` constructed in `tests/v1/attention/test_attention_backends_selection.py:32-48`; that object has no `get_prefill_checkpoint_alignment`, so this unconditional dynamic call raises `AttributeError` before either parameterized case reaches its assertions. Add the default hook to that fixture or otherwise retain a safe default for this existing caller.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
